31.title: OaZ Clubroom Access Guide
31.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

The access system can register only a limited number of student IDs. As previously announced, only full members will be granted clubroom access with their student IDs.

Associate members who need to use the clubroom can contact an officer if the door is locked. We will open it for you. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Thank you.

33.title: Find Classmates Taking the Same Courses
33.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

For the first time, OaZ is connecting members who are taking the same courses. We’ll set up a KakaoTalk group for each course so you can share assignment and exam information or find partners for a project or study group. We hope this helps members get to know one another and support each other at university.

How to participate
Enter your current courses in the Google Form. We’ll match members by course and invite them to a group chat.

Sign up: https://forms.gle/Bu4u8RrXCTbAWaREA

Who can participate: All OaZ members
Sign-up period: Monday, March 9 through Saturday, March 14, 2026
Group chats open: Sunday, March 15, 2026

A chat will be created only if two or more members are taking the same course.

We look forward to your participation. Thank you.

30.title: Restricted Access to the OaZ Clubroom Through Friday, March 6
30.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

Interviews for new OaZ members will take place from 14:00 to 19:00 each day from Tuesday, March 3 through Friday, March 6, 2026.

During those hours, please leave the clubroom to interviewees and the interview team so that the interviews can run smoothly. Other members should refrain from using the room during the interview period.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

37.title: Join the Introductory Deep Learning Study Group
37.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

We are recruiting members for the introductory deep learning study group.

Time: We will agree on a time using the responses to the Google Form.
Location: The OaZ clubroom or a study room in the New Engineering Building.

Application deadline: Friday, March 20, 2026 at 23:59.

38.title: Join the Introductory Web Development Study Group
38.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

We are recruiting members for the introductory hands-on web development study group for the first semester of 2026.

When: Fridays, 16:00–18:00.
Where: OaZ clubroom, Room 106B on the first floor of the New Engineering Building.
Who can join: Students interested in websites who can read basic code in any language. We will use GPT to help write code. You do not need strong coding skills, but you should be able to follow the structure of the code and make changes.

Application form: https://forms.gle/LSmY4eFE9QiLQvkM7
Application period: Tuesday, March 17 through Friday, March 20, 2026 at 23:59.

Study schedule
Week 1: Orientation, Ubuntu installation and virtual environment setup
Week 2: Review the OaZ website code
Week 3: Learn to use GitHub Desktop or Fork
Week 4: Classes and Tailwind
Week 5: HTML and CSS
Week 6: userstate and def
Weeks 7–8: Hands-on web development

Please feel free to apply or contact us with questions. Thank you.

35.title: Python Basics Study Group Recruitment
35.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

As announced at the semester opening meeting, the introductory Python study group is recruiting. If you were provisionally assigned to the group and would like to take part, please fill out the Google Form again. You can also apply if you were not assigned to the group.

Time: The group will agree on a meeting time.
Location: The OaZ clubroom or a study room in the New Engineering Building.
Who can join: New programmers, students looking to strengthen their Python fundamentals, and anyone who has written Python but would like to understand their code better.

Application form: https://forms.gle/qbX7xv7Jq47hD2xa9
Deadline: Thursday, March 19, 2026 at 23:55.

Thank you.

36.title: Join the VLSI & EDA Study Group
36.body:
Hello from the OaZ officers.

We are recruiting for the VLSI & EDA study group. If you are interested in semiconductor design and electronic design automation and are looking for a place to start, this group may suit you.

Time: We will agree on a time using the responses to the Google Form.
Location: OaZ clubroom, Room 106B in the New Engineering Building.
Who can join:
- Students who know basic Python syntax and can write simple scripts.
- Students who understand basic digital circuits and have encountered combinational circuits, sequential circuits and finite-state machines.
- Students with some experience of Verilog or SystemVerilog.
- Students interested in understanding and analyzing data structures.
- Students who can commit to the project during the vacation.

Read the study description and apply here: https://forms.gle/CgxSYn5MYUgWjNALA
Deadline: Friday, March 20, 2026 at 23:59.

Please contact us if you have any questions. Thank you.

52.titleKo: [홍보] SK쉴더스 루키즈 지능형 애플리케이션 개발자 양성과정 6기 모집 (~5/10)
52.title: SK Shieldus Rookies: Intelligent Application Developer Training, Cohort 6 (Through May 10)
52.body:
Application deadline: Sunday, May 10, 2026.

Eligibility: Unemployed applicants in their third year of university or above, in Korea or abroad, who are eligible for a National Tomorrow Learning Card.

Apply at ssra.kr or use the QR code in the announcement.
Training period: Friday, May 22 through Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Classes run Monday through Friday, 09:00–18:00 (8 hours a day, 960 hours in total).

Locations: Regular classes take place online in a metaverse classroom. In-person practical training takes place at SK Shieldus headquarters, and the final project at Dongguk University's Seoul campus.

There are 50 places. Early applicants receive priority. Final selection follows document screening and an online interview.

Benefits include an opportunity to interview with SK Shieldus on completion, practical classes and mentoring by its staff, a training allowance of up to KRW 300,000 per month, and an additional accommodation subsidy for trainees living outside the area. The participant contribution is KRW 500,000 toward a course valued at KRW 17 million. Laptop loans and access to AWS, metaverse and AI services are provided.
